full_judgment: This Petition for Leave to Appeal has been filed against an order dated 26-8-2010 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.25185 of 2010. Directing the respondents to surrender before the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jhenaidah, within 8(Eight) weeks from date with a further direction to the law enforcing agencies not to arrest or harass or disturb them in any manner presumably in connection with the Shailokupa Police Station case No.8 dated 11-8-2010, filed under sections 143/341/323/326/302/114/34 or the Penal Code, pending in the Court of the Judicial Magistrate, Jheniadah. The High Court Division also made an observation that the concerned Court "may enlarge the petitioners on regular bail considering the facts, circumstances and materials on record" if they surrender as per direction.
